FISHING LICENCE · AUSTRALIA

Australian Capital Territory fishing licence

No recreational fishing licence is required in public ACT waters. Googong Reservoir is in New South Wales, so the NSW fishing fee applies despite ACT management.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Extra stamps and permits

  • NSW recreational fishing fee
    For Googong Reservoir, unless a NSW exemption applies.

Rules visitors should know

  • Use no more than two rods.
  • Stay within 10 metres of your rods and keep them in sight.
  • Do not use live fish, fish eggs or frogs as bait.
  • Release protected fish.

How to buy

No ACT licence purchase is required. Pay the NSW fee before fishing at Googong unless exempt.

Sources (1)
  1. ACT Government

Checked November 2026. Prices and rules change: confirm on the official site before you fish.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Australian Capital Territory?

No recreational fishing licence is required in public ACT waters. Googong Reservoir is in New South Wales, so the NSW fishing fee applies despite ACT management.
